name: dsh-delete-guard
description: Redirect shell deletions into the OS Recycle Bin. Intercepts known deletion forms at tools/pre-execute (pwsh, bash, cmd, the persistent terminal) and answers with a file_trash call that uses Win32 SHFileOperationW, so the content stays recoverable. Also catches content destroyed without a delete verb — an in-place rewrite of the only copy, an unchecked slice endpoint — and a named set of permanent-erase shapes: wipe programs, disk cmdlets, emptying the bin, and anything built at run time. UNC shares have no Recycle Bin, so a share deletion is staged to a local NTFS volume and verified before the original goes. The README lists what is not covered.
author: deepestevan
